c: Mix starches; pour in boiling water (100 °C) all at once; stir; cover 5 min; add lard; knead smooth.
Keep under a damp cloth; roll 8 g balls and press thin with an oiled cleaver (7 cm).
Pat prawns dry; chop half coarse, slap the other half into a paste with salt until sticky.
Mix with chopped chives, blanched diced fat and bamboo, starch, sugar, pepper, sesame oil; chill 30 min.
Fill 16 g per skin; pleat into half-moons; steam 6 min on high in lined baskets, 4 per basket.

c: Scald starches with boiling water; rest 5 min covered; knead in oil; roll 11 g pieces to 8 cm rounds.
Soak shrimp and shiitake 30 min; dice; dice jicama 5 mm; crush peanuts.
Stir-fry pork in oil until opaque; add shrimp, shiitake, jicama; season; bind with starch slurry; add chives; cool.
Fill 14 g; fold into a crescent with a pinched ridge; steam 7 min.

c: Chop ribs into 2.5 cm pieces; rinse under cold running water 15 min until clear; drain and pat dry.
Rinse and lightly mash black beans; fry with garlic in oil 30 s; cool.
Mix ribs with all seasonings and starch; marinate 2 h at 0–4 °C; add sesame oil last.
Portion 105 g into small plates; steam 15 min on high until the meat pulls from the bone; garnish with chilli.
6fbb8d19.st: Cool to < 8 °C within 90 min; chill 0–4 °C, 3 days. Re-steam once to ≥ 75 °C core.

c: Clip claws; blanch 5 min; dry well; brush with diluted maltose; dry 1 h.
Deep-fry at 180 °C 6–8 min until blistered (use a splatter lid); plunge into iced water 2 h until puffy.
Simmer feet in all braise ingredients 45 min until soft; drain, toss with a little starch.
Steam in small plates 10 min before service.
76c4c203.st: Raw dumplings: freeze on trays at −18 °C, bag, 1 month; steam from frozen +2 min. Cooked: hold ≥ 63 °C max 1 h in the steamer; never re-steam twice.

c: Mix beef with baking soda, salt and ice water; beat in a mixer 5 min until bouncy and sticky.
Fold in soaked minced chenpi, chopped water chestnut, herbs, seasonings and starch; chill 1 h.
Roll 22 g balls on blanched beancurd skin or lettuce; steam 8 min (core ≥ 72 °C); serve with Worcestershire-style dip.
9511752f.st: Raw dumplings: freeze on trays at −18 °C, bag, 1 month; steam from frozen +2 min. Cooked: hold ≥ 63 °C max 1 h in the steamer; never re-steam twice.
9511752f.al: 1 Gluten (soy sauce) · 6 Soybeans (soy sauce) · 11 Sesame (sesame oil).

c: Whisk all; rest 30 min. Ladle 100 g onto an oiled tray; steam 2 min on full steam until translucent.
Make you tiao dough, rest 4 h; stack two strips, press, fry at 190 °C until puffed and deep golden.
Roll a piece of hot you tiao inside each rice sheet; cut 4; sauce with sweet soy (soy, sugar, water 1:0.5:1), sesame, scallion.
d928afd2.st: Assemble to order: fried dough loses crunch within 10 min of rolling.
d928afd2.al: 1 Gluten (wheat starch, wheat flour, soy sauce) · 6 Soybeans (soy sauce) · 11 Sesame (sesame seeds).

c: Knead 8 min to a smooth semi-firm dough; proof 40 min; divide 22 g; roll thin-edged 8 cm rounds.
Set stock with gelatine (or trotter aspic) overnight; dice 5 mm.
Beat pork with seasonings and ginger-scallion water until sticky; fold in aspic.
Fill 23 g; pleat closed; proof 15 min.
Pan-fry pleat-side down in oil 2 min; add water 1 cm deep; cover and cook 8 min until dry; uncover, crisp bases.
Sprinkle sesame and scallion; serve 4 per portion with black vinegar.
967718a3.st: Raw dumplings: freeze on trays at −18 °C, bag, 1 month; steam from frozen +2 min. Cooked: hold ≥ 63 °C max 1 h in the steamer; never re-steam twice.

157b9c13.yl: Yield: 20 portions of 2 slices · Portion: 106 g
c: Shred daikon; simmer in its own juice 15 min until translucent; cool slightly.
Fry diced sausage, soaked shrimp and shiitake in oil until fragrant.
Mix rice flour, starch and water; stir into the warm daikon with all aromatics and seasoning to a thick paste.
Pour into oiled tins; steam 50 min; cool, chill overnight; cut 2 × 6 cm slices.
Pan-fry slices 3 min each side until golden crust; serve with XO or chilli oil.
157b9c13.st: Steamed cake chilled 0–4 °C, 4 days; freeze slices 1 month. Fry to order.
157b9c13.al: 1 Gluten (wheat starch) · 2 Crustaceans (dried shrimp) · 6 Soybeans (chinese sausage).

c: Steam peeled taro 25 min; mash smooth while hot.
Scald wheat starch with boiling water; knead into the taro with lard, sugar, salt, five-spice and soda; chill 1 h.
Dice 5 mm; stir-fry; season; thicken with starch slurry; chill completely.
Wrap 13 g filling in 32 g taro; shape ovals; freeze 15 min.
Fry at 180–185 °C 3 min (hot oil = honeycomb lace); drain.
Use fresh oil; fry 5 pcs at a time to keep the temperature.
a17492ef.st: Shaped raw puffs frozen 1 month; fry from frozen at 175 °C 4 min.
a17492ef.al: 1 Gluten (wheat starch, oyster sauce, soy sauce, shaoxing wine) · 2 Crustaceans (prawns) · 6 Soybeans (oyster sauce, soy sauce) · 12 Molluscs (oyster sauce) · 14 Sulphites (shaoxing wine).

c: Scald wheat starch with 80 g boiling water; mix with glutinous flour, sugar and remaining warm water; knead in lard.
Stir-fry; thicken; cool. Wrap 12 g in 30 g dough into rugby shapes.
Fry at 160 °C 6 min turning, then 175 °C 1 min until golden and puffed.
3b2c282f.st: Shaped raw: freeze 1 month. Fried: serve within 15 min.
3b2c282f.al: 1 Gluten (wheat starch, oyster sauce, soy sauce) · 2 Crustaceans (dried shrimp) · 6 Soybeans (oyster sauce, soy sauce) · 12 Molluscs (oyster sauce).

c: Water dough: 270 g flour, 60 g lard, sugar, water; oil dough: 180 g flour, 120 g lard. Rest both 30 min.
Wrap oil dough in water dough; roll, fold in thirds twice; roll into a log; cut 25 g; roll thin.
Dice roasted char siu 5 mm; bind with a thick hoisin-oyster gravy; chill.
Fill 20 g; seal into triangles or rectangles; egg-wash; sesame.
Bake 200 °C 20–22 min until layered and golden.
491b173e.st: Baked: 1 day ambient airtight, re-crisp 180 °C 5 min. Raw shaped: freeze 1 month.
491b173e.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour, oyster sauce, hoisin sauce, soy sauce) · 3 Eggs (eggs) · 6 Soybeans (oyster sauce, hoisin sauce, soy sauce) · 11 Sesame (hoisin sauce, sesame seeds) · 12 Molluscs (oyster sauce).

c: Chop prawns coarse; beat with pork, salt and starch until sticky; fold in diced soaked shiitake, bamboo, scallion, ginger and seasoning; chill.
Wipe bean curd sheets with a damp cloth to soften; cut 15 × 15 cm.
Roll 21 g filling tightly into 8 cm logs; seal with flour paste.
Steam 6 min to set; cool; fry at 175 °C 2–3 min until blistered and golden (core ≥ 72 °C); cut on the bias.
c7de74d0.st: Steamed rolls 0–4 °C 2 days; fry to order.
c7de74d0.al: 1 Gluten (oyster sauce, wheat flour) · 2 Crustaceans (prawns) · 6 Soybeans (oyster sauce, bean curd skin) · 11 Sesame (sesame oil) · 12 Molluscs (oyster sauce).

c: Blanch skin-side down 2 min; prick skin densely with a needle tool; rub meat side with salt, sugar, five-spice, nam yu and wine.
Brush skin with vinegar; dry uncovered skin-up at 0–4 °C overnight.
Wrap sides in foil; cover skin with a 1 cm coarse-salt crust; roast 180 °C 60 min.
Remove salt; roast 240 °C (or grill) 20–25 min until fully blistered; rest 15 min; chop 1 cm with a cleaver.
aaeaaaff.st: Cool to < 8 °C within 90 min; chill 0–4 °C, 3 days. Re-crisp skin at 220 °C 6–8 min; serve sliced to order.
aaeaaaff.al: 1 Gluten (shaoxing wine) · 6 Soybeans (red fermented bean curd) · 14 Sulphites (shaoxing wine). Not halal.

c: Chinese rose wine (mei kuei lu chiew)
Spread the cavity paste inside; sew the vent shut with a skewer.
Inflate skin from the neck (air pump) to separate fat; scald with boiling water 3 times.
Dissolve maltose in hot vinegar and water; ladle over the duck 3 times; hang in front of a fan 4–6 h (or overnight at 2 °C).
Hang-roast 200 °C 50–60 min, rotating, until mahogany (core thigh 75 °C).
Drain the cavity jus, skim, season; chop duck Cantonese-style; serve with plum sauce.
d50f7322.st: Cool to < 8 °C within 90 min; chill 0–4 °C, 3 days. Re-crisp skin at 220 °C 6–8 min; serve sliced to order.
d50f7322.al: 1 Gluten (hoisin sauce, soy sauce) · 6 Soybeans (hoisin sauce, soy sauce) · 11 Sesame (hoisin sauce).

c: Chinese rose wine (mei kuei lu chiew)
Bring master stock (see Lou Seui) to a bare simmer 90 °C; dip and lift the chicken 3 times to equalise cavity temperature.
Submerge; poach 20 min below simmer; turn off the heat, cover and steep 20–25 min (thigh core 74 °C).
Brush with sesame oil; rest 15 min; chop; spoon over strained stock.
Use the house Lou Seui; top up seasonings after every 4 birds.
fb179915.st: Cool to < 8 °C within 90 min; chill 0–4 °C, 3 days. Serve at room temperature within 4 h or chilled.
fb179915.al: 1 Gluten (soy sauce, dark soy sauce) · 6 Soybeans (soy sauce, dark soy sauce) · 11 Sesame (sesame oil).

c: Rub the bird with salt; rinse. Bring water with ginger and scallion to the boil; dip and lift 3 times.
Plunge into iced water 15 min (tightens skin, sets jelly); hang, brush with sesame oil; chop.
Finely mince ginger and scallion; add salt; pour over smoking-hot oil (200 °C); stir.
beca2fa8.st: Cool to < 8 °C within 90 min; chill 0–4 °C, 3 days. Serve at room temperature within 4 h. Oil keeps 3 days chilled.
beca2fa8.al: None of the 14 declared allergens. No major allergens in the base recipe.

c: Wash rice 3 times; cook 1 : 1.2 water; rest 10 min.
Blanch choy sum 60 s in salted oiled water; dress with oyster sauce.
Roast gravy: stock + roast drippings + soy, thickened lightly with starch.
Plate 200 g rice, 90 g siu yuk, 100 g roast duck, 60 g greens, 30 g gravy (meats per their TTKs).
3103d210.st: Rice: cool < 8 °C within 90 min, 24 h; never hold warm rice > 2 h (B. cereus).
3103d210.al: 1 Gluten (oyster sauce, soy sauce) · 6 Soybeans (oyster sauce, soy sauce) · 9 Celery (chicken stock) · 12 Molluscs (oyster sauce). Meats: allergens per their TTKs.

c: Toast spices; tie in muslin with chenpi. Simmer all 45 min.
After each use: skim, strain, boil 5 min, cool < 8 °C in 90 min, refrigerate.
Every 2 weeks (or after 8 birds) replace spice bag; refresh with 10% fresh soy and sugar; log date and boils.
dea2f517.st: Chill 0–4 °C; boil 5 min every 3 days if unused, or freeze. Log every boil.
dea2f517.al: 1 Gluten (soy sauce, dark soy sauce, shaoxing wine) · 6 Soybeans (soy sauce, dark soy sauce) · 14 Sulphites (shaoxing wine).

c: Soak scallops and shrimp 2 h; steam scallops 20 min; shred; mince shrimp.
Fry shallots, then garlic in 160 °C oil separately until light golden; set aside.
Fry scallop, shrimp, minced ham and sausage slowly 20 min until crisp at the edges.
Combine all with chillies, seasonings and the oil; simmer 140 °C 10 min; jar, covered with oil.
f674ad25.st: Jars under oil 0–4 °C, 1 month; clean spoon only.
f674ad25.al: 1 Gluten (oyster sauce, shaoxing wine) · 2 Crustaceans (dried shrimp) · 6 Soybeans (chinese sausage, oyster sauce) · 12 Molluscs (dried scallops, oyster sauce) · 14 Sulphites (shaoxing wine).

c: Whisk eggs and sugar to ribbon stage (8 min); fold in sifted flour, custard powder and baking powder; rest batter 1 h (for tall, open crumb).
Fold in milk and oil; pour into a lined steamer.
Steam on full steam 30–35 min, lid wrapped in a cloth; skewer clean; cut warm into wedges.
11e192f7.st: Best warm within 2 h; chilled 2 days, re-steam 5 min.

c: Julienne ginger fine; mix into Chinkiang/red vinegar; rest 1 h.
Infuse oil with spices and garlic at 120 °C 15 min; strain over chilli, sesame and salt at 160 °C; cool.
Mix to a paste with cold water; rest 10 min to develop heat.
cc8aa4e5.st: Chill 0–4 °C: vinegar 1 week, chilli oil 1 month, sweet soy 2 weeks, mustard 2 days.
